meta.direction: Technical atlas: hairline engineering drawings on warm white. Instrument Sans + IBM Plex Mono.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground. Warm near-white, the drawing paper.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: The sheet: right panel, menus, step detail.

tokens.name: panel-2
tokens.usage: Inputs, open step, chart and figure grounds.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Rules between sections. Hairlines, never boxes.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Row rules inside a table or list.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, axes, the drawn marks (the revision triangle, balloons).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill (selected toggle, primary button, back chip).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Labels and captions (mono).

tokens.name: ink-4
tokens.usage: Placeholders.

tokens.name: person-cooper
tokens.usage: Cooper's trials, avatar and lines. Person colors mean a person and nothing else. White initials on the light value are 4.4:1, slightly under 4.5 for 11px bold. Kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: person-greeshma
tokens.usage: Greeshma's trials, avatar, lines and the 'in use' ring on instruments she's using.

tokens.name: person-lena
tokens.usage: The PI's avatar. A neutral grey because she owns no trials in the story.

tokens.name: on-person
tokens.usage: Initials on a person-colored avatar disc.

tokens.name: status-goal
tokens.usage: ✓ goal met. A filled disc with an on-status check. Status colors are never used for people or for instruments.

tokens.name: status-close
tokens.usage: ○ passes every check but misses the target. Drawn as a 2.5px ring on status-close-bg. The light value is 2.5:1 on panel, under the 3:1 floor for a mark; kept exact from the source. Proposed fix: #b98200 (3.4:1).

tokens.name: status-close-bg
tokens.usage: Fill inside the ○ ring.

tokens.name: status-fail
tokens.usage: ✕ fails a check. The glyph on status-fail-bg.

tokens.name: status-fail-bg
tokens.usage: Disc behind the ✕ glyph, and the failing side of a limit on charts.

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: The check inside the filled ✓ disc.

tokens.name: goal-region
tokens.usage: The goal corner on the chart: resin cream, from the figures.

tokens.name: goal-ink
tokens.usage: The word Goal on the chart.

tokens.name: log-auto
tokens.usage: Logs itself: a filled ink square.

tokens.name: on-log-auto
tokens.usage: Instrument name on a log-auto tile (4.2:1 light at 11px semibold; 6.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: log-hand
tokens.usage: By hand: a half-filled ink square (fill side).

tokens.name: log-hand-line
tokens.usage: By hand: the square outline.

tokens.name: log-none-line
tokens.usage: Not logged: an empty ink square.

tokens.name: fixture
tokens.usage: Room fixtures (fume hood, sink): drawn as outlines, never as equipment.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Legacy, from the first workspace: unintended differences and the T09 highlight. New screens mark deviations with a dashed ink outline instead, so amber doesn't collide with status-close.

tokens.name: amber-bg
tokens.usage: Legacy, paired with amber.

tokens.name: amber-ink
tokens.usage: Legacy text on amber-bg.

tokens.name: sel
tokens.usage: Selection: ring on the chart, row tint edge, the open balloon. Taken from the figures' UV.

tokens.name: sel-tint
tokens.usage: Selected row and log line background.

tokens.name: uv
tokens.usage: Figure tone: UV light and lit screens in the Anatomy drawings.

tokens.name: resin
tokens.usage: Figure tone: resin. Same as goal-region.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps; padding inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between step tiles, avatars and list rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside control groups; padding of small tiles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row padding (vertical) and gap between inline items.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between the main view and the right panel.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Card padding; the page side gutter at every width.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top padding of a page; gap between home sections.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, the source square, FUTURE labels.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Step tiles, number tiles, table wrappers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the right panel, chart panels, the floor plan.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The Projects/Lab toggle, chips, avatars, the back chip.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: In-flow panels that need lift off the canvas. Most cards use a hairline instead.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, the search overlay, the back chip.
